title: A Wreck for the Escarpment
author: Paloma Brightwater
blurb: Marguerite Zhou, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
